run_knn_segmentation: run KNN-based semantic segmentation on ViT or XCiT patch embeddings using FAISS for nearest neighbor search
load_dataset_voc: load a VOCSegmentation dataset with image and target transforms for train or val splits
extract_embeddings_vit: extract and normalize patch-level embeddings from a Vision Transformer model using a data loader
build_faiss_index: build a FAISS flat index with cosine or L2 metric from train patch embeddings for KNN retrieval
compute_segmentation_metrics: compute accuracy and Jaccard scores on KNN segmentation predictions at patch and full resolution
